en: Vintage monochrome (green-tinted) postcard showing a winter landscape with a wide river or rapids running between snowy, forested banks. On a hill in the background stands a large building complex identified as a hotel. There is printed red caption text at the bottom left and publisher information at the bottom edge, with handwritten cursive text across the lower portion of the card.
